none: PAS PUBLIC-2CA903: Late Roman copper alloy nummus
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A badly worn copper alloy Nummus of the house of Constantine, dating from 330 to 335 AD. Worn image of bust right on the obverse with the worn inscription, 'GLORIA EXERCITVS', of which only the 'X' is apparent . On the reverse are 2 standard bearers with the inscription 'PLG' below, indicating the coin was minted at Lyon. Maximum diameter: 15.04 mm, Thickness: 1.74 mm, Weight: 0.054 gms
